lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines. Spacing is broader on the anterior and mid-torso and becomes progressively tighter as the lines approach the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Two abbreviated line segments are visible on the posterior haunch and one on the anterior shoulder area that terminate before reaching the full vertical extent of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 7 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch/upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible on the mid-thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, originating with an outward-backward sweep before curving inward and forward at the terminal tips relative to the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers perched on the dorsal ridge; high-contrast orange/tan fur on the lower limbs below the carpal and tarsal joints.
